data.name: Kakele Online - MMORPG
data.detailed_description:
Kakele is a retro-styled 2D MMORPG with modern features. It is a game with a top-down view, offering a classic RPG experience in an expansive, open-world environment. Dive into a vibrant, hand-crafted universe where exploration, combat, and teamwork are key elements of your adventure!

🐾 Capybara and Other Pets!

Start your adventure with a capybara! It will assist you in battle and enhance your skills. Along the way, unlock new pet designs with unique abilities for different situations. With every update, new pets that transform your playstyle are introduced!

🌍 Global Events and Challenges!

Global events that bring together servers from all regions to interact. Enter the global fortress and fight for your server, playing alongside people from all over the world!

💱 Global Economy Controlled by Players!

In Kakele, the market is interconnected across servers worldwide and entirely player-driven. Buy and trade with over 10,000 players across the servers.

📡 Servers in Various Regions of the World!

Servers available in multiple regions worldwide. Play without lag and with people who speak your language. Form guilds and enjoy over 4 years of released content!

📱 Play on Any Device!

Play smoothly on any device and internet connection. In Kakele, one of our main goals is to make the game accessible to everyone. Play on mobile phones, older computers, and slow internet connections without any issues and with 100% enjoyment!

⚔️ Join a Growing Community!

Whether you're a lone explorer or a guild-focused strategist, Kakele offers endless adventures and a welcoming global community ready to fight by your side. With frequent updates, community-driven improvements, and new content always on the horizon, there’s never been a better time to jump in. Start your journey today and become part of the world of Kakele!

data.short_description: Kakele Online is a 2D MMORPG! It is a cross platform top-down multiplayer open world nostalgic, modern and classic 2D pixel art real time role playing game. Play on Mobile and PC! Player driven economy with fair monetization! Play for FREE!

English*, Spanish - Spain*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Polish*, Spanish - Latin America*
*languages with full audio support
data.reviews:
“I’ve tested out dozens of mobile MMOs over the years and I’ve never been able to get into any of them. This is the first mobile MMO I’ve actually been able to get into. The gameplay is fun and challenging, and the systems in place feel like a true retro MMO. I was also really impressed by the GUI and tutorial. Normally, mobile MMOs feel extremely overwhelming by throwing a ton of complex systems and hard to understand GUI right from the start, which turns me away from wanting to learn the game. I was pleased to see that wasn’t the case here—the game is very user friendly and easy to pick up. So far I’ve been loving the game and am excited to keep on exploring and learning the vocations.”
4.5/5 – App Store

“This is honestly very underrated game ngl, dude this even has a voiceline and this is the very first game i saw to have voiceline with low downloads, and the story, a masterpiece... This deserves 5 stars from me And also, i didn't get bored because of the story, and quest like any other mmorpg, the only thing that gets me bored is the long distance 💀 to walk to, good thing there's a skill that maximizes your speed”
4.5/5 – Play Store

“BEST GAME FOR MOBILE EVER, TIBIAME SUCKS”
9.3/10 – Indie DB
